doctrine.core_thesis: Attention arbitrage is the only durable marketing advantage. The window always exists; incumbents ignore current winners while early movers compound. Reputation equity and brand attention, built over 4-6 years, generate more durable revenue than 90-day CAC tactics. In service/B2B businesses, personal brand IS the moat.

algorithm_first_marketing_model.principle: Stop debating in boardrooms. Post, measure, learn. Let organic performance validate creative before committing paid spend.
algorithm_first_marketing_model.organic_validation_gate: Organic must prove before paid amplifies. Working:non-working media ratio shifts from 85:15 toward 50:50 as creative effectiveness proves ROI.
algorithm_first_marketing_model.interest_media_beats_follower_graphs: Platform interest-graph distribution (content reaching non-followers by topic) outperforms follower-count reach strategy.
algorithm_first_marketing_model.key_role_to_hire: Views editor (algorithm-literacy specialist) as core marketing ops role, not additional brand manager.

content_production_operating_model.scale_proof: 412 posts/day across 81 handles as a demonstrated operating benchmark.
content_production_operating_model.p_and_h_process: Platforms and Handles framework: unblocks executive voice at scale; routes the right content to the right handle/platform context.
content_production_operating_model.experiential_events: Treat events as content production factories, not attendance milestones.
content_production_operating_model.documentation_over_expertise: You do not need to be the expert. Document what you are learning in real time. Process content beats polished authority content for audience-building speed.
content_production_operating_model.context_is_unscalable_leverage: Volume with context (right platform, right angle, right audience segment) is the moat competitors cannot copy at speed.

attention_arbitrage_playbook.day_trading_attention: Deploy resources to wherever attention is underpriced right now. The window is always temporary; early movers compound.
current_underpriced_windows_2026: Live shopping on TikTok Shop and WhatNot ($500B opportunity, 2012-era social scale moment)
Interest-graph organic social (algorithm rewards signal over follower count)
IP and V Friends category (collectibles/merch cycling back into collector phase)
attention_arbitrage_playbook.historical_proof_pattern: Wine Library TV: 7 years of daily video before breakout. Email in 1997. Patience is the mechanism, not the obstacle.
attention_arbitrage_playbook.evening_economy_window: 9pm-12am is the critical build window for employed side-income builders. Day job and evening build are not mutually exclusive.

accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.100_percent_accountability_age_25_plus: After 25, external blame is no longer valid operating logic. Full ownership of outcomes.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.cynicism_tax: Cynicism defaults are a regret tax. Practical optimism (maybe-mindset, test-first) compounds; cynicism forecloses options.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.power_of_no: Effectiveness on prior commitments before accepting new ones. No is a production tool, not a weakness.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.work_life_balance_reframe: Balance does not exist as a concept. Loving yourself AND holding yourself accountable simultaneously is the actual operating state.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.ivan_drago_detachment: Emotional detachment from outcomes (if he dies, he dies) enables higher-quality decision-making and removes performance anxiety.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.ai_comfort_mandate: AI discomfort is not a valid operating position in 2026. ChatGPT as excuse-eliminator: any knowledge gap is now a choice, not a constraint.
accountability_and_mindset_operating_rul.forgiveness_and_humility: Core operating levers for long-arc founder durability, not soft skills.

personal_brand_and_service_business_doct.reputation_over_tactics: Reputation arbitrage beats lead-gen tactics in premium B2B services. Revenue follows brand equity over 4-6 years.
personal_brand_and_service_business_doct.personal_brand_is_the_moat: In service businesses, the founder's personal brand is the primary differentiation mechanism. It cannot be replicated by a competitor.
personal_brand_and_service_business_doct.no_original_ideas: Personality is differentiation, not novelty of concept. The market is won on voice, consistency, and audience trust, not on unique ideas.
personal_brand_and_service_business_doct.micro_segmentation: Broad demographic targeting is blunt. Micro-segmented audiences (interest-specific, context-specific) convert at higher rates and compound faster.
personal_brand_and_service_business_doct.influencer_outreach_for_b2b: Influencer relationships in B2B contexts follow same value-first logic. Lead with value; do not pitch on first contact.

co_founder_and_team_operating_principles.counter_punch_communication: Address co-founder issues as they arise, not on rigid scheduled check-ins. Real-time resolution beats batched retrospectives.
co_founder_and_team_operating_principles.family_or_founder_takeover: Execution plus patience beats strategy plus audacity in succession or takeover situations. Prove competence inside first.
co_founder_and_team_operating_principles.team_culture: Culture is transmitted through demonstrated behavior, not stated values. Founders model the operating standard.

live_shopping_specific_tactics.tiktok_live_cadence: 2 hours per day of TikTok Live for discovery. Consistency of live presence is the compounding variable.
live_shopping_specific_tactics.women_dominating_affiliate: Women currently lead affiliate and live-shopping verticals; category is wide open for anyone willing to do the volume.
live_shopping_specific_tactics.local_first_broadcast_scaling: Build community broadcast presence locally first, then scale the model. Community density before geographic breadth.
live_shopping_specific_tactics.wholesale_commerce_application: Live shopping principles apply to wholesale commerce; the channel is not limited to DTC or creator contexts.

value_content_framework.any_of_three_works: All three attract audiences. Choose the one that is most authentic to your actual unfair advantage.

metrics_and_numbers_to_know.working_nonworking_target: 50:50 working:non-working media ratio as the organic-first model matures
metrics_and_numbers_to_know.content_volume_benchmark: 412 posts/day / 81 handles as an enterprise-scale operating proof point
metrics_and_numbers_to_know.tiktok_live_minimum: 2 hours/day for meaningful TikTok Live discovery signal
metrics_and_numbers_to_know.brand_build_timeline: 4-6 years to reputation equity that drives revenue without direct sales effort

what_to_ignore_from_source: Stan Store and WhatNot ad reads (3+ appearances, not doctrine)
Podcast/seminar boilerplate timestamps and audience prompt scaffolding (80%+ of segs 11-30)
Specific NFT/crypto ticker calls (cyclical speculation, not operating principle)
